method: Each salary row is attributed across the clubs the player appeared for that season, pro rata by PA + (league PA per inning) * IP at each club. See this builder's header for the four read-time exclusion rules and docs/contracts-data-caveats.md for the population regimes. coverageRows and coverageDollars are SEASON figures and sit on the season alone: an unattributed row has no club, so no club-specific coverage rate exists.
